basis: The Q3 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure. For the three months ended September 30, Celsius reported consolidated GAAP revenue of $265,748,000 in 2024 versus $384,757,000 in 2023, below the $365,519,150 threshold. The September warnings quantified a decline in Pepsi orders. Management supplied no upper bound for revenue from other customers, so those warnings could not establish a ceiling for consolidated revenue.

coverage.detail: May 7, preceding earnings cycle. Celsius reported Q1 revenue of $355.7 million and an approximately $20 million Q1 impact from distributor inventory movements. The release gave no Q3 consolidated revenue forecast.
On the May 7 call, the CFO’s high-40s percentage outlook covering Q2, Q3 and Q4 referred to gross margin.
August 6, immediately preceding earnings release. Celsius reported Q2 revenue of $402.0 million, up 23%, and discussed lower distributor inventory. It gave no numeric Q3 consolidated revenue outlook.
The August 6 investor presentation showed Q2 and first-half financial results, retail sales through July 14 and expected international launches. None supplied a Q3 consolidated revenue ceiling.

On the August 6 call, an analyst explicitly asked whether the inventory impact would recur in Q3. The CFO said the $20 million to $30 million range discussed in June had landed near its low end for Q2 and that he could not predict the distributor’s Q3 orders.
August 28. Celsius announced public September 4 and September 10 webcasts about Q3 inventory, category share and business trends. The notice contained no sales estimate.

September 4, Barclays. Toby David clarified that Pepsi orders were running $100 million to $120 million below Q3 2023. Subtracting that range from prior-year consolidated revenue gives $264.757 million to $284.757 million only if other revenue stays flat and the order reduction flows through to recognized revenue. Management gave no such consolidated forecast.

September 10, Piper Sandler. In the transcript of management’s public remarks, David again attributed the $100 million to $120 million decline to purchases by Pepsi, Celsius’s largest customer. He gave no company-wide Q3 revenue range.
The September 19 Form 8-K listed only Item 5.02, concerning directors or officers.
The October 29 Form 8-K also listed only Item 5.02.
October 30. Celsius scheduled its Q3 results for November 6 before market open. The notice contained no preliminary figures.

November 6. The issuer’s release gives both September-quarter comparatives in the same consolidated statement of operations. The revenue row, in thousands of dollars, shows 265,748 for 2024 and 384,757 for 2023.

publication_date_evidence: Celsius’s investor-relations release displays November 6, 2024. The matching SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries a November 6 dateline and states that Celsius reported its third-quarter results that day.
